label: Runtime
description: Exposes elapsed-time measurements for the current XShell runtime instance.

startTimeMs.description: Date when the Runtime instance was constructed.

startupDurationMs.description: Performance.now() timestamp captured when the Runtime instance was constructed, in milliseconds relative to the browser's performance time origin.

uptimeMs.description: Elapsed milliseconds since the Runtime instance was constructed, calculated using performance.now().

timings.description: Recorded bootstrap and runtime timing checkpoints.

record.description: Records a new timing checkpoint for the specified phase.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: The name of the phase to record.
